settings.editor: A comprehensive range of micromanufacturing services tailored to your exact needs, from precision small-hole drilling to features as small as 1 micron. Our technologies support everything from aerospace components to fully fabricated microfluidic devices advancing biotech and medical diagnostics.

settings.title: Check out our growing list of capabilities

settings.editor: We are innovators at our core, constantly evolving to meet market demands and pioneering new micro-manufacturing technologies.
Fast-turn prototype paths with DFM feedback so design teams get real parts on compressed timelines.
4-axis CNC milling and drilling for fine-feature metals and engineering plastics at ±10 µm tolerances.
Micro-holes down to a single micron in almost any substrate: vias, nozzles, filters and dense arrays.
UV and IR laser processing for ultra-fine features in metals, polymers, glass, ceramics and thin films.
Micro-scale additive manufacturing for intricate geometries conventional processes can't reach.

settings.title: Changing the world one micron at a time

settings.editor: Our customers span many industries: medical device, biotech, semiconductor, automotive, aerospace and more.
Micro-drilling for microfluidic devices, precise vias, channels and ports in glass, polymers and foils, from rapid prototyping to scalable production.
Laser-drilled micro-holes in glass and polymer vials and ampoules for container closure integrity and leak-test system validation.
High-resolution micro-hole drilling for concealed displays, precise, uniform holes for invisible backlit indicators and controls.
Quick, cost-effective small-hole drilling in most materials, microholes as small as 1 micron in almost any substrate.
Micro-hole drilling for probe cards in silicon nitride, polyimide, Ultem and other engineered substrates.
Precision laser micro-hole drilling for medical catheters, hole sizes down to microns, biocompatible materials, ISO 13485 and fast turnaround.
